title: Chaos with Keywords: Exposing Large Language Models Sycophantic Hallucination to Misleading Keywords and Evaluating Defense Strategies

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with sets of misleading keywords across various domains (e.g., pairing a person with an award they did not win) and measuring the factual accuracy of the generated statements to evaluate the model's tendency to hallucinate information that aligns with the user's implied false premise.
